question: The specify stage's scope check cannot pass on this branch, and the only way to make it pass would break your decision. The change artifacts under openspec/changes/add-zone-rules-from-iana/ and the change record are in place, so only this check is failing. How should this go forward?
options: Re-base the task start (or move the 'gnomish: task started' marker after the merge ba035ca) so the scope check measures from the merged main; I keep the three files and change nothing else
